candidate_windows.window_text: Note that the implementation details are described in the Appendix A.1.

In our experiments, we employ BART (Lewis et al., 2020) as the initialization parameters of UniRPG and optimize it with AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019). Table 7 displays all the hyperparameters for the TAT-QA and DROP datasets during training and inference. Our experiments are all performed on 1 NVIDIA A100 GPU. Table 7: Hyperparameters of UniRPG during training and inference on the TAT-QA and DROP dataset.
ParametersTAT-QADROP
baselargelarge
Learning Rate1e-41e-41e-4
Batch Size128256256
Weight Decay0.010.010.01
Gradient Clipping555
Warmup Steps0.010.010.01
WarmupLinearLinearLinear
Maximum Decoding Steps505050
Beam Size444
Training Epochs303020
